scope: Clean-source literal percentages rewritten as natural words; original allocations and controls retained.

records.english: {SPEAKER:02}So we give you 2 percent of Nantes for 1 percent of Lisbon?{PAD}
records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil checks the proposed exchange after the other trader rejects a one-for-one share exchange because Lisbon is larger and strategically placed.
records.source_meaning: Lil asks whether giving up two percent in Nantes means receiving one percent in Lisbon in exchange.
records.localization_note: Keeps both amounts, cities and exchange direction in a natural confirmation question. Writes percent as a word because ASCII percent-space-o becomes an octal conversion; no manual breaks.
